notes.title: How billing works
notes.seats: You pay per planner: the studio includes you, and each colleague is a seat. Couples and vendors never count.
notes.change: Add or remove planners any time; the next invoice follows.
notes.readOnly: When a trial ends without a plan, nothing is deleted. Weddings are read-only until you choose one.
